pr_body:
This changes the behavior to not copy all file attributes, but to still copy the nocow bit by default unless explicitly configured by the caller. It also introduces `COPY_NOCOW_AFTER` after to have the copy functions try to disable COW after copying the file. We switch all use cases that make ephemeral copies to not forcefully enable NOCOW to prevent unexpected full copies where reflinks are expected.

Fixes #34089

review_comments:
hmm, so, if i set the nocow flag on some dir i then copy a file into with this, we'll end up with the nocow flag enabled with this patch, regardless how the flag was set on the source file.

do we want that? we do, or don't we?
this probably should have an explicit comment about this: saying that we propagate the nocow flag being on, but not being off.

"source is COW" is a bit misleading here, because if the source on ext4 then the NOCOW flag will be off, but the source is still not COW at all, given that ext4 doesn#t know such a concept, hence maybe say "source is not NOCOW", just to avoid any confusion
maybe add a comment here: `/* If caller explicitly requested NOCOW to be set or unset, let's not interfere */`
